cited.quote: there is a team of Palliative Care Nurse and Physiotherapist offering Home Base Palliative and Physiotherapy services

rationale: C2 and C3 show physiotherapy only as home-based/mobile team services under the Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam scheme, and C4 mentions physiotherapy rehabilitation generally. None shows physiotherapy centres being established in ward level hospitals or any Physiotherapy Council advice. Related activity only.

cited.quote: Minimum pension of Rs.7,850/- per month has been fixed with effect from 01-10-2017

rationale: C1-C3 describe minimum pension and gratuity, but the minimum pension was fixed with effect from 01-10-2017, before the government took office on 2021-05-07, and no extract shows a new step by this government. C4 and C5 are about tax and a Pongal prize, not this commitment.

cited.quote: Flood Management Advisory Committee headed by Dr.V.Thiruppugazh,I.A.S. (Retired), vide G.O. (D) No.362, Municipal Administration and Water Supply Department, dated 22.10.2021
Advisory Committee on Mitigation and Management of Flood Risk in Chennai Metro was formed

rationale: C3 and C2 show the Chennai Metro flood risk Advisory Committee formed by G.O. (D) No.362 dated 22.10.2021; C1 says it comprises experts. C3 and C2 also show storm water drain works sanctioned and taken up. Both limbs are met, though committee composition is only partly shown.

cited.quote: An Act to provide for the prohibition of sex selection, before or after conception

rationale: C2 and C3 describe the central PC & PNDT Act of 1994 and its enforcement (prosecutions, decoy operations). That law predates this government and no extract shows a new legal order by the state banning female foeticide. C4 is a general women policy; C5 is about plastics.

cited.quote: Restoring degraded forest areas by undertaking tree planting and soil moistu re conservation efforts
Government has sanctioned an amount of Rs.45.41 crore for removal of invasive species Lantana camara

rationale: C5 is the GO of 2021-11-03 setting up the Tamil Nadu Green Climate Company to run the Green Tamil Nadu Mission, including restoring degraded forest. C1/C3 are a 2022 restoration policy GO. C2 reports sanctioned funds and large-scale removal and restoration work. Effectiveness is not fully measurable.

No extract is about the Sethusamudram Shipping Canal Project. C1 is a ports policy GO whose map only labels a channel alignment; C2-C5 concern drainage, irrigation, tourism and ports works. No official step on the project is shown.

cited.quote: the beneficiaries are given 8 gram gold coin along with cash assistance of Rs.25,000/- which is disbursed as Rs.15,000/-

rationale: C1-C3 show the existing inter-caste marriage scheme (SC/ST with other community) giving an 8 gram gold coin with Rs.25,000 or Rs.50,000, not the promised Rs.60,000 special assistance for an ST partner. No extract shows an order raising the amount. C4 and C5 are about other matters.

cited.quote: procured from 25 Women Co-operative Societies functioning under the Department of ICDS

rationale: C1 and C3 show an existing arrangement where 65% of Sathumavu is bought from women cooperative societies, with the rest by open tender; it is for ICDS, not mid-day meals, hostels or cafeterias, and not exclusive. No new dedicated measure is shown. C4 and C5 are GST notifications.

cited.quote: DCMPUs are imparting training to the staff/members of the Milk Co-operative Societies in clean milk production

rationale: C2 shows ongoing routine training of milk producers and society staff in production topics. No extract shows workshops for dairy cooperatives on professional management or any new order for them. C1, C3-C5 describe structure and procurement only.

cited.quote: Tamil Nadu Uniformed Services Recruitment Board published the Notification on 08.03.2022 for recruitment of Sub-Inspectors of Police
The selection process was completed and appointment orders were issued to all qualified candidates

rationale: C1 and C2 show 2022 recruitment notifications for police posts (SI 08.03.2022, constables 30.06.2022); C3 shows a 2023 recruitment cycle completed with appointment orders. Two cycles are evidenced; nothing for other years or that all vacancies were filled annually.

cited.quote: After careful examination of the proposal of Commissioner of Tourism, the Government accords administrative sanction for implementing

rationale: C5 (and C2) is G.O.(Ms) No.200 dated 18.06.2025 giving administrative sanction for developing eight Navagraha temples under the PRASHAD pilgrimage tourism scheme. This is a dedicated official measure on pilgrimage tourism, though it is infrastructure-focused and centrally funded.

cited.quote: constitute a Committee with the following composition to come-up with a revival plan for the tourism sector

rationale: The only committee order, C4, is a post-Covid tourism recovery committee, not one to design and promote spiritual tourism trips. C5 mentions pilgrimage only as one niche segment in destination guidelines; C1-C3 describe PRASHAD infrastructure. No committee for spiritual tourism is shown.

cited.quote: The Powerloom Weavers Cooperative Societies primarily produce cloth for the Free Uniform Supply to School Children

rationale: C1 and C2 say powerloom cooperatives primarily produce uniform cloth, and C3 notes uniform production under a tender-based process. No extract shows an order awarding school uniform contracts exclusively to powerloom weavers. C4 and C5 concern electricity subsidy and textile policy.

cited.quote: urban slum families living in kutcha houses in thatched / tiled roof without a toilet

rationale: C1, C2 and C4 mention grants to build houses for kutcha-house families without toilets, which is household housing, not common toilets in kutcha-house areas. C3 is labour rules for plantation toilets; C5 only lists toilet indicators. No common toilet step shown.

cited.quote: Anganwadi employees working in 54,439 Anganwadi centres in Tamil Nadu are given with the special time scale of pay

rationale: C1-C3 describe existing pay scales and benefits for Anganwadi and noon meal employees, following the 7th pay commission, with no dated new order by this government on appointment or pay. C4 builds Anganwadi centres and C5 is about wages compensation, both different subjects.

cited.quote: reduction of selling price of milk of all variants by Rs.3/- per litre w.e.f. 16.05.2021

rationale: C4 reports the reduction of Aavin milk selling price of all variants by Rs.3 per litre effective 16.05.2021, with revised rates listed; C5 repeats it. The effective date is after the government took office on 2021-05-07, and the scope matches the promise.

cited.quote: one shall belong to Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe and one shall be a woman

rationale: C1-C3 describe trustee boards with reserved seats only for Scheduled Caste/Tribe and women. No extract shows any reservation for the Viswakarma community. C4 and C5 are about audit, lands and the policy note index.

cited.quote: a unanimous resolution was passed in this Assembly in 2022 urging the Union Government not to implement the recommendations
Government considers this action of the University Grants Commission as solely an indirect attempt to impose the Hindi language

rationale: C2 records an Assembly resolution passed in 2022, after this government took office, urging the Union Government against Hindi as medium of instruction in Union institutions. C1 adds a government statement against the UGC third-language circular as an indirect Hindi imposition.

cited.quote: a unanimous resolution was passed in this Assembly in 2022 urging the Union Government not to implement the recommendations
and strongly urges the Union Government not to implement the same

rationale: C1 records a unanimous Assembly resolution in 2022 urging the Union Government not to implement Hindi-related recommendations; C3 shows the government strongly urging the Union Government against the UGC circular. These are formal steps addressed to the Union, though not literally described as representations.

cited.quote: National Medical Commission granted permission for admission of 150 MBBS students each in the 7 New Government Medical Colleges
At present, there is no Government Medical College in six Districts of Ranipet, Tirupathur, Kancheepuram

rationale: C2 shows 11 new Government Medical Colleges permitted in 2021-22 and inaugurated on 12.1.2022. C3 (2025) says six districts still have no Government Medical College and the state has asked the Union for grants. Some districts covered, others not.
